_description: CDN icon path + filename rules for webp/ (flat public surface; one bulk namespace exception)

bulk_namespaces.webp/material-icons/: curated icon pack (~1k+); internal storage, not primary CDN surface

layout.note: Brand/product icons live flat at webp/*.webp; only bulk import packs use subdirs

basename.uniqueness: globally unique basename across webp/*.webp (flat root is canonical CDN)
basename.collision_with_bulk: if basename exists in a bulk namespace (e.g. material-icons/), prefix flat file by product family

prefix_tiers.when: Microsoft-branded app or service where 'Microsoft' is part of the product identity
Azure cloud service or Azure-branded SKU (not generic microsoft-* app)
Large product family ingested as a set; prefix avoids clutter and collisions
Globally recognized standalone brand; bare name is unambiguous at CDN root
Tool known by its own name (may be Microsoft-owned); use bare name unless it collides

prefix_tiers.override: use explicit --out when first label is ambiguous or collides

decision_order: 1. Is this a bulk import pack? → webp/material-icons/ (or future pack dir); do not flatten
2. Would bare basename collide with webp/*.webp or webp/material-icons/*.webp? → prefix by family
4. Microsoft-branded app (Copilot, Defender, 365 admin, etc.)? → microsoft-{product}.webp
5. Part of a vendor suite (aws-, macos-, adobe-, amazon-)? → {vendor}-{product}.webp
6. Standalone brand or --domain default? → {name}.webp at webp/ root

squircle_cli.batch: --out-dir webp/ (flat); do not recreate deprecated brand subdirs

maintenance.on_add: pick tier from decision_order; never add webp/{brand}/ subdirs for single icons
maintenance.on_collision: rename newer or less-canonical file; keep one winner at flat root
maintenance.material_icons: webp/material-icons/{name}.webp is non-canonical for CDN; root wins when names differ
